audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 matches a 51.55% Vel'Koz win rate over 6448 games — an early poke lane Thresh has to survive before his kit turns on.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-2].side all read "Skill" but content win[0-2] and packet.levelChart[0-2] all say "Vel'Koz" — the full-layer chart contradicted its own content layer for the first three rows.
audit.why: Vel'Koz's double-Q and W poke out-range and out-damage Thresh before Flay/The Box come online at 4+, matching the content whys already on file.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side -> Vel'Koz, with whys and ratings rewritten to match; win[0-2] already correct, left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Vel'Koz's true damage (Organic Deconstruction (P), Life Form Disintegration Ray (R)) bypasses resistances, but itemization never says so.
audit.why: Stacking armor/MR caps out against true-damage sources; the correct answer is HP and dodging the beam, not resistances.
audit.corrected: report[8] itemization rewritten to name the true-damage bypass.

edits.before: Auto-chip with the passive's armor souls pending — the scythe trades start the collection.
edits.after: Vel'Koz's double-Q and W poke zone you and your ADC before your hook has real punish power.

edits.before: Hook online: the lane plays behind minions or meets the sentence.
edits.after: His Q-W combo can chunk half a bar before Flay comes online, so the trade stays his.

edits.before: Full kit: hook-flay-lantern is the playbook and every brush is a courtroom.
edits.after: Full Q-W-E lets him zone your hook step with Tectonic Disruption and keep the poke lead.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Dark Passage answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Tectonic Disruption (E) is 12-10s and starts the true-damage rotation — dodge the knockup and Organic Deconstruction stalls. - Life Form Disintegration Ray is a 2.5s channel on 100/90/80s; break it with Flay. - Spend your R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Hook the gap, flay the landing, lantern the collapse — the full sentence pays the whole team.
edits.after: Stand at your 1075-range hook while he pokes — souls collected safely fund the passive without walking into his 1050-range Q.

edits.before: Fishing predictably while the souls walk past — the collection IS the scaling; greed the hooks, not the chips.
edits.after: Don't burn Flay just to interrupt chip poke — save it to break his R channel or punish the all-in, not to answer a stray Q.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket / Zeke's, Mobility-Mercs, then Knight's Vow paths.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket / Zeke's, Mobility-Mercs, then Knight's Vow paths. His P and R deal true damage late — stack HP and dodge the beam, not resistances.

notes: Chart rows 0-2 were self-contradictory (full said Skill, content and packet both said Vel'Koz); fixed to Vel'Koz across side/why/rating, win[] untouched since it was already correct. suspectNames flagged 'Life Form Disintegration Ray' as a possible typo but it matches enemyAbilities.R exactly — false positive, no action taken.
